note: Fallback catalogue for POST /errors/explain; the agent composes a version grounded in the manual when available.

items.title: Something went wrong on our side
items.message: That did not go through, and it was not anything you did.
items.cause: The server hit an unexpected problem.
items.nextStep: Try once more. If it fails again, open Help and raise a ticket so the team can look.

items.title: One of the fields needs another look
items.message: The form could not be saved as it is.
items.cause: A required field is empty or in the wrong format.
items.nextStep: Check the fields marked required, fix them and save again.

items.title: That email address does not look right
items.message: We could not save the contact.
items.cause: The email is missing an @ or a domain.
items.nextStep: Correct the email, for example name@example.com, and save again.

items.title: Pick a promised time that is a real date and time
items.message: The job card was not updated.
items.cause: The promised time could not be read as a date and time.
items.nextStep: Choose the date and time from the picker rather than typing it.

items.title: Please sign in again
items.cause: Sessions expire after a period of inactivity or when the demo restarts.
items.nextStep: Sign in again; your work on this page is not lost.

items.title: Your role cannot do that
items.message: This action is not part of your role.
items.cause: Each role sees its own pages and actions; this one needs a different permission.
items.nextStep: Ask your general manager to do it, or to change your role. Help can tell you who can.

items.title: The dataset catalogue is for managers
items.message: The Domo datasets are not available to your role.
items.cause: Only general managers, sales managers, finance and digital experience users can read the datasets.
items.nextStep: Ask a manager to pull the dataset for you, or use the dashboard figures.

items.title: Only the general manager can recompute signals
items.cause: Recomputing dealer signals changes what the website promotes, so it is limited to the general manager.
items.nextStep: Ask the general manager to run it, or use Preview first.

items.title: We could not find that record
items.message: It may have been moved, merged, or is at a site you cannot see.
items.cause: The identifier does not exist, or it belongs to another site.
items.nextStep: Go back to the list and search again, or ask Help to find it.

items.title: That job card is not available to you
items.cause: Technicians see their own cards; the card may be assigned to someone else or be at another site.
items.nextStep: Check the number, or ask your service manager.

items.title: That deal is not in your pipeline
items.cause: Salespeople see their own deals; the deal may belong to a colleague.
items.nextStep: Search for the customer in Deals, or ask your sales manager.

items.title: Someone got there first
items.cause: The record changed, or is already on hold or reserved.
items.nextStep: Refresh the page to see the latest, then try again.

items.title: That car is already on hold
items.cause: Another hold exists on this stock unit.
items.nextStep: Choose another unit, or ask the holder to release it.

items.title: That file is too big
items.cause: Files must be 6 MB or smaller.
items.nextStep: Reduce the photo size or split the document and upload again.

items.title: We can only take PDF, PNG, JPEG or text files
items.cause: The file type is not supported.
items.nextStep: Convert the file, for example save the photo as JPEG, and try again.

items.title: The assistant is busy
items.message: Too many requests came in at once.
items.cause: Answers are rate limited to protect the knowledge box.
items.nextStep: Wait ten seconds and ask again.

items.title: The knowledge box did not answer
items.message: Your question could not be answered just now.
items.cause: The knowledge box was unreachable or slow.
items.nextStep: Try again in a moment. The manual chapter on this page is still available.

items.title: The service is warming up
items.cause: The server was restarted.
items.nextStep: Wait a few seconds and refresh.

items.title: The document is still being read
items.cause: Large PDFs can take longer than one request allows.
items.nextStep: Press Process again in about 30 seconds; it picks up where it left off.

items.title: That took too long
items.cause: The answer needed more time than allowed.
items.nextStep: Try a shorter question or try again.
